title: Divergence: is_adt_fold_sum is oracle-fitted to the literal-0-base sum_list shape — the GROUNDED Tree fold (value-carrying base) fails to lower+verify (R-DEFER-9)

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Failing test at thermite-lower/tests/divergence_adt_fold_generality.rs::divergence_tree_fold_does_not_lower_and_verify demonstrates the divergence. ROOT CAUSE: is_adt_fold_sum (thermite-lower/src/lower.rs) is the SOLE gate for the '-> nat' return coercion (lower_spec_fn_ret) of an ADT fold, but it hard-requires a UNIT-variant base arm whose body is the LITERAL 0 (has_unit_zero: Pattern::Enum{fields empty} with body IntLit 0). The design's GROUNDED Tree fold (.design/basis/01-adts.md recorded finding: 'a tree_sum fold was also confirmed to verify' + REQ-10) has a VALUE-CARRYING base (Leaf(v) => v as u64), so is_adt_fold_sum returns false, the spec fn lowers '-> u64' (not nat), and the recursive arm tree_sum(*l) + tree_sum(*r) is int-typed -> verus rejects: 'match arms have incompatible types: expected u64, found int'. The lowering is fitted to the literal-0-base sum_list corpus shape, not the general Box-recursive structural fold REQ-10 grounds (R-DEFER-9 corpus-gaming). The fold BODY itself flows through the general lower_match path correctly; only the nat-return detection is shape-fit. A len-style fold (1 + len(*t), literal-0 unit base) IS detected and works — confirming the gate keys on the base-arm shape, not generality.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Fix (single file thermite-lower/src/lower.rs): generalize is_adt_fold_sum from a literal-0-base shape-fit to a STRUCTURAL recursive-fold predicate. The nat-return coercion (lower_spec_fn_ret) gated on has_unit_zero (a unit-variant base arm whose body is IntLit 0), so the GROUNDED Tree fold's value-carrying base (Leaf(v) => v as u64) was missed -> lowered -> u64 -> recursive arm tree_sum(*l)+tree_sum(*r) int-typed -> verus E0308 incompatible match arms. New detection: the match has at least one arm that recurses through a Box-deref'd field (f(*x)), with NO base-arm literal requirement; expr_has_deref_call_arg now walks the full arm-body expression tree (so Node(l,r)=>f(*l)+f(*r) and Cons(h,t)=>h as T+f(*t) both match). The nat return then coerces every arm uniformly (Cast -> as nat). sum_list/len (literal-0 base) unchanged; tree_sum now verifies 1 verified, 0 errors. Authority: .design/basis/01-adts.md REQ-10 + recorded structural-recursion finding; goal.md R-DEFER-9.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: RESULT (commit 03138c8): #69 fixed. is_adt_fold_sum generalized from the literal-0-base shape-fit to a STRUCTURAL recursive-fold predicate in thermite-lower/src/lower.rs (single file, +57/-44). New detection: arms.iter().any(|arm| expr_has_deref_call_arg(&arm.body)) — a match with at least one arm recursing through a Box-deref'd field (f(*x)), NO base-arm literal requirement; expr_has_deref_call_arg now walks the full arm-body expression tree. The -> nat return then coerces every arm uniformly (Cast -> as nat). Tree fold (Leaf(v)=>v as u64, value-carrying base) now lowers -> nat and REAL verus verifies: 'verification results:: 1 verified, 0 errors'. No regression: list_sum/len/bank_account/shape still L3 (adt_lower_conformance 10/10); sum/binary_search unchanged; deposit/is_circle still L3; whole workspace green.
